title: Bouquet
lyrics_trans: [MISAMO "Bouquet" Lyrics] [Verse 1: Mina, Momo If time returns and I can meet me that day, I'll hold you gently What will be, will be, baby I couldn't fall in love with myself, I couldn't go as expected, and I fell in love with you in a world where I couldn't fall in love with myself, and couldn't go as expected, so I'll fall in love with you in a world where I can't fall in love with you [Pre-Chorus: Sana] Even if you can't smile, it will be fine Let's laugh [Chorus: Mina, Momo Sana It's fine to stay like me, so I don't push myself too hard until the day I can fall in love with my bad self, and I'll grow a kind heart and save someone I can gently stand on my trembling feet and go beyond my faith It's okay I'm laughing in the future, line up the stones that I've tripped over and polish them It shines Shining It'll become a gem [Ishi] [Verse 2: Momo, Sana I realized that I was protected by someone from the beginning I can see your shadow in the corner of the picture of my memory On the day my love withered and dried, I somehow found it raining, wet and cold when it got cold [Pre-Chorus: Mina] When I woke up from my dreams, the warmth of the wiped marks remains [Chorus: Momo, Sana Mina Thank you I'm sure you're not alone, but because you've always been by your side, I feel like I can love my past self too If it's just a fun day, I didn't notice my wounded heart, and I couldn't save anyone I'll gently hold my fingers and promise I'll deliver it to the future, so let's bundle up and make uneven flowers One of the worlds my bouquet, ooh [Break: Mina] Ah-ah [Chorus: Sana, Mina Momo It's fine, it's fine to stay me, so I don't push myself too hard.
